why_source_matched: the non-thinking mode is the only arm whose Pivot supply is exhausted. Filling only its cell from a new source (design R2, priced beside this one) would make 77% of A2's schema_arguments tokens synthetic and 0% of A1's: a source difference confounded with the mode, the variable under test. Matching the source composition costs one synthetic top-up per arm.

reused.not reused: no frozen pack, manifest or suite is edited: these arms get new manifests and packs; state evaluation with the synthetic cell would be a new suite identity (state_eval_hybrid@v3), never a rewrite of v2-lc1

recorded_per_arm: selected examples, turns, tool calls and tool-calling decisions per category and per source group
unique supervised tokens split into reasoning, answer and tool-call tokens
packed sequences, non-padding tokens, optimizer steps, supervised-token exposure, training FLOPs (compute measures only; never a data size)

fallback.reads_only: verified teacher supply under tool_verification@v2 (the dev box's tool_admission census); never a student, search, training or evaluation result
fallback.rule: a schema_synth group short after its whole supply is attempted is extended by the same generator's next instance indices of the same domains (existing tasks unchanged, a new extension content imported by task identity), never by lowering a verifier, repeating a task, borrowing across splits or counting after packing; a Pivot group cannot be short (sealed)

interpretation_limits: schema_synth tasks are programmatic: their language is compositional templates with paraphrase, distractors and corrections, not organic user requests; schema_arguments is 15% of the tool type, about 2.5% of each arm's base category
equal supervised tokens are not equal tasks, tool calls or compute: the non-thinking arm holds about 4-10x the schema tool-calling decisions of a thinking arm at the same tokens
C1 vs A1 secondary and confounded (initialization protocol)

the three schema_synth state-evaluation domains are held out from the training domains but share the generator and its derivation patterns: they test domain hold-out, not generalization to real unseen tool-calling tasks; that needs an independent real tool-calling evaluation later

the per-source targets inside schema_arguments are targets: whole episodes overshoot them, and each arm's real per-source and per-category composition is reported from its frozen selection, never asserted as exact
